svg.title: Project similarity
svg.desc: Public projects positioned by t-SNE using README text, descriptions, topics and language presence. The same input similarity selects the shown links. Distances in this two-dimensional projection are approximate; global distances and apparent cluster sizes are not calibrated. Equal-area markers show display categories, with no importance or expertise weighting. Fixed-radius point halos show qualitative density of this layout. Labels prioritize previously reviewed proof links where complete descriptions fit, without changing geometry. The linked site provides the accessible project catalogue and methods.

text.font-family: 'FiraCode Nerd Font Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
